name: cc-plugins
description: Anthony Baldwin's Claude Code plugins: a dashboard above the prompt, status-driven terminal tinting, and native desktop notifications.

plugins.name: statusline-dashboard
plugins.description: Mod: an opinionated dashboard above the prompt with collapsible rows — context with a per-category breakdown, rate-limit windows with pace balance, cost, activity and sub-agents, git/PR, and config-scope breakdowns. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: session-color
plugins.description: Tints the terminal background by session status — amber while Claude works, red when it needs you, green when it's done — per pane, so a wall of sessions reads at a glance. macOS, Linux (tmux-aware), Windows.

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude finishes or needs input, with elapsed time, a button that focuses the originating terminal tab/pane, an open-in-editor button, and an optional AFK webhook (Discord, Slack, ntfy, Gotify). Windows (WinRT) and macOS (UserNotifications).
